file.managed.description: Ensure a file exists with the desired content, permissions, and ownership.

content.description: desired inline file content; provide either content or source (source wins if both are set)

context.description: extra template variables, available as top-level names; override defaults; only used when template is enabled

defaults.description: fallback template variables; context takes precedence; only used when template is enabled

group.description: file group name; ownership is left unchanged when unset

makedirs.description: create missing parent directories (with mode 0755); a boolean that also accepts the integers 1 (true) and 0 (false)

mode.description: file permission mode in octal ("0644", "0755", "4755"); setuid/setgid/sticky bits honored; defaults to 0644

name.description: absolute path to the target file; the path alias is accepted for Salt compatibility; defaults to the state ID

source.description: local file path to copy content from; provide either content or source (source wins if both are set)

template.description: render source/content as a Jinja2 template before writing (a bool, the string "jinja", or a truthy/falsy string); defaults to off

user.description: file owner username; ownership is left unchanged when unset

pkg.installed.description: Ensure a system package is installed, optionally pinned to an exact version.

name.description: package to install (defaults to the state ID)

refresh.description: refresh the package cache before installing

version.description: exact version pin; any other installed version converges via install or downgrade (format depends on the detected package manager)

pkg.latest.description: Ensure a package is installed and kept at the newest available version.

name.description: package to keep at the newest available version (defaults to the state ID)

refresh.description: refresh the package cache before Check and before Apply

pkg.purged.description: Ensure a package is removed along with its configuration files.

name.description: package to purge, including its configuration files (defaults to the state ID)

pkg.removed.description: Ensure a system package is not installed.

name.description: package to remove (defaults to the state ID)

service.dead.description: Ensure a service is stopped, optionally disabling it at boot.

enable.description: boot-enablement intent: enable:false also disables the unit; unset or true leaves it alone

name.description: service unit name (defaults to the state ID)

service.running.description: Ensure a service is running, optionally managing its boot enablement.

enable.description: boot-enablement intent: unset leaves it alone, true enables, false disables

name.description: service unit name (defaults to the state ID)

user.present.description: Ensure a user account exists with the specified attributes.

createhome.description: create the home directory when creating the account

fullname.description: GECOS full-name field; only compared and set when non-empty

gid.description: primary group as a numeric GID or a group name; an integer or all-digit string is a GID, any other string is a group name (taking precedence over primary_group)

groups.description: supplementary groups the account should belong to

home.description: home directory path; only compared and set when non-empty

name.description: username for the account; defaults to the state ID

optional_groups.description: supplementary groups added only if the account is already a member (absent groups are skipped, never created)

password.description: pre-hashed shadow password; converged by comparing the account's current shadow hash

primary_group.description: primary group name; used only when gid is not itself a group name

remove_groups.description: remove supplementary groups not listed in groups (otherwise existing groups are preserved)

shell.description: login shell path; only compared and set when non-empty

system.description: create a system account (low UID range)

uid.description: numeric user ID; only compared and set when non-zero (0 auto-assigns)

FileMode.description: A Unix file-permission mode. Accepts an octal string ("0644", "755", "4755") or an integer whose value is the octal mode number (a YAML octal literal such as 0644 parses to 420). The setuid, setgid, and sticky bits (4000/2000/1000) are honored.

GroupRef.description: A group reference, given as a non-negative integer GID or a group name. An all-digit string is treated as a numeric GID, so "1000" and the integer 1000 resolve identically; a negative GID is rejected.

StringList.description: A list of strings. Accepts a single string (a one-element list), a list of strings, or a mixed scalar list whose elements are rendered to strings. A nested list or map element is rejected rather than dropped.

TemplateFlag.description: A template-rendering flag. Accepts a bool, the string "jinja", or any truthy/falsy string (true/yes/1/on, false/no/0/off). Zester renders with Jinja, so any enabling value means "render with Jinja".

TriState.description: A three-valued boolean: unset, true, or false. Accepts a bool; the truthy/falsy string set (true/yes/1/on, false/no/0/off, case-insensitive); or an integer, where 1 is declared-true and 0 is declared-false — any other integer (for example 2) is a typed error, never silently ignored. The unset state lets a module tell "not specified" apart from an explicit false.

description: A Zester state file (state ID -> exactly one module name -> parameters), generated from each module's self-documenting schema (keystone spec). Only migrated modules are constrained via $defs.modules; a module absent from it has no schema yet and is left unconstrained.
title: Zester module parameters
